title: Towing Dispatch Work Order Form
subtitle: Towing Dispatch: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Towing Dispatch Work Order Form covers disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery. The towing dispatch coordinator records Towing Dispatch authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Towing Dispatch Work Order Form keeps Towing Dispatch exceptions visible until the towing dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Towing Dispatch Work Order Form at roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location. Document disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery identity before Towing Dispatch begins. Compare disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery findings with stated Towing Dispatch criteria; route unresolved Towing Dispatch issues to qualified towing operations reviewer. For Towing Dispatch Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Towing Dispatch. Ask qualified towing operations reviewer to review Towing Dispatch conditions beyond the towing dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Work-order reference and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Towing Dispatch, identify responsible parties, roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location, and the linked disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery source.

fields.label: Vehicle VIN or plate, make, model, color, and location
Truck, operator, equipment, destination, and custody references

sections.title: Work-order tasks, resources, and results
sections.guidance: Capture Towing Dispatch facts for disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Towing Dispatch authorized-work checks
items: Road, traffic, weather, visibility, and scene safety
Vehicle position, damage, mobility, drivetrain, and clearance
Tow method, attachment, securement, and special equipment
Occupant, key, property, and law-enforcement context
Departure, route, storage, and destination handoff

sections.title: Scope exception, work status, and handoff
sections.guidance: Resolve open Towing Dispatch conditions; have towing dispatch coordinator assign the next Towing Dispatch owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Scope changes, holds, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle requires different equipment or recovery plan
blocks.guidance: Pause Towing Dispatch when scene safety, authority, equipment fit, securement, destination, or vehicle custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Towing Dispatch proof and route unresolved disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery scope to towing dispatch coordinator.
